title: We become what we practice
idea: Aristotle held that we become just by doing just acts and brave by doing brave acts. Character is built by repeated action, not by wishing.
apply: Choose one trait you want. Define one small action that expresses it, and do it daily for two weeks.
remind: Act your way into the person you want to be.
who: Hal, who wants to be more patient with his kids.

items.x: He wants to be a patient father
Every night he promises to do better

scenes.nar: Hal wants to be a patient father. At bedtime he snaps, and every night he promises to do better tomorrow.

msgs.x: I am just not a patient person.
A month of wishing has changed nothing.

scenes.nar: He decides he is just not a patient person. A month of wishing has changed nothing.

items.x: Pick one small act: three slow breaths before replying
Repeat it daily for two weeks

scenes.nar: Aristotle said we become just by doing just acts. Hal picks one small, patient act: three slow breaths before he replies at bedtime, every night.
Within weeks the breaths become automatic. Bedtime is calmer, and his kids notice. He did not wait to feel patient. He practiced it.
